FULL TEXT:
INTERDISCIPLINARY CENTRE FOR SWAMI VIVEKANANDA STUDIES,
PANJAB UNIVERSITY CHANDIGARH
ADVERTISEMENT Dated 22/02/2024
GUEST FACULTY REQUIRED IN ICSVS
No. of Position:1
Walk-in-interview on 1st March 2024 at ICSVS for the appointment of on Guest Faculty
teachers cum instructors to teach certificate course Elementary Sanskrit and Bhagavad-
Gita (ESB) Interdisciplinary Centre for Swami Vivekananda Studies, (ICSVS) Panjab
University Chandigarh for the Session 2024-25.
Name of Post: (1) Assistant Professor in Sanskrit/Indian
Philosophy
Essentials: M.A.in Sanskrit/ Philosophy (With specialization in
Indian Philosophy)
Desirable: Ph.D. in Sanskrit/Indian Philosophy/UGC Net /JRF
in Sanskrit/Indian Philosophy
Experience of teaching Sanskrit/ Indian Philosophy
for at least one academic session in any educational
Institution
Last Date for Application Submission: 28.2.2024.
All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificate and other relevant documents
for verification along with the duly filled form giving the following details at the time of
interview:
1. Name
2. Date of birth
3. Educational Qualification (with percentage from 10th onward Attached self-
attested Photocopies)
4. Attested photocopy of Degree M.A./ Ph.D.
5. Teaching Experience (attach details)
6. Any other relevant documents like Projects completed (self-attested)
7. Publications etc.
8. Correspondence Address
9. Contact No./ Mobile No.
10. E-mail ID
The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture
with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for the interview.
Sd/-
(Prof. Shivani Sharma)
Coordinator, ICSVS
